name: reading-passages-03
description: 7 ảnh bìa (vẽ lại không người, cảnh mới) cho bài đoạn văn Luyện đọc mới (đợt 2026-10-30).

jobs.subject: close view of a weekly class timetable sheet pinned on a classroom wall: a grid of colored boxes with no writing, one box highlighted in muted brick red; a round wall clock without digits hangs beside it. No people anywhere in the scene, an empty quiet still life.

alt.vi: Tờ thời khóa biểu dán tường phòng học cạnh đồng hồ treo tường.

jobs.subject: an empty dormitory corridor: one blank paper notice pinned on a cork bulletin board; below it an old bicycle leaning against the wall and a small television set on a wooden chair. No people anywhere in the scene, an empty quiet still life.

alt.vi: Hành lang ký túc xá: tờ thông báo trên bảng tin, xe đạp cũ và ti vi nhỏ để tặng.

jobs.subject: a quiet empty Japanese street corner seen from a small station exit in the morning: a bank, a post office, a small park, a tiny cafe and an old two-storey building with three bicycles parked in front; all signs blank. No people anywhere in the scene, an empty quiet still life.

alt.vi: Góc phố nhìn từ ga: ngân hàng, bưu điện, công viên và tòa nhà cũ có xe đạp.

jobs.subject: a club room corner: a bulletin board with one blank invitation sheet pinned on it; a fishing rod and a straw hat lean against the wall beside it; through the window a calm river with grassy banks. No people anywhere in the scene, an empty quiet still life.

alt.vi: Thư mời trên bảng tin câu lạc bộ, cạnh cần câu và mũ, ngoài cửa sổ là dòng sông.

jobs.subject: an empty dormitory lobby wall: one blank paper notice taped to the wall, below it a wall air conditioner, a closed window with a latch and a light switch next to the entrance door. No people anywhere in the scene, an empty quiet still life.

alt.vi: Tờ nội quy dán trên tường sảnh ký túc xá, cạnh điều hòa và cửa sổ đóng.

jobs.subject: an empty clean Japanese tatami room for rent: a built-in closet with its sliding door open, a wall air conditioner, a window with soft daylight; through an open sliding door a small shared kitchen-dining area with a table is visible. No people anywhere in the scene, an empty quiet still life.

alt.vi: Căn phòng kiểu Nhật trống có tủ âm tường, điều hòa, nhìn sang bếp ăn chung.

jobs.subject: a small clean canteen near a station seen from inside by the window: on the counter a tray set meal with grilled fish, a small meat dish, vegetables, rice and miso soup; empty tables and chairs behind; all signs and menus blank. No people anywhere in the scene, an empty quiet still life.

alt.vi: Khay cơm cá nướng, thịt và rau cạnh cửa sổ nhà ăn nhỏ gần ga.
